name: xwz-parking-system
description: Root orchestrator for XWZ Parking Management System microservices

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd Backend/api_gateway && npm install && cd ../auth_service && npm install && cd ../billing_service && npm install && cd ../entry_service && npm install && cd ../packing_service && npm install && cd ../report_service && npm install && cd ../../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,PARKING,ENTRY,BILLING,REPORT,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,blue,green,red,white" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:parking" "npm run dev:entry" "npm run dev:billing" "npm run dev:report" "npm run dev:frontend"
